report_title: # P0028 ARC12 Compatibility Portfolio Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive development packet measures a bounded P0028 generic compatibility portfolio on P0027's immutable sixth disjoint 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 filename-only cohort. The controller now evaluates every initial generic theory against visible training demonstrations before the fixed beam may prune it; this prevents an unobserved, shorter identity theory from evicting a uniquely training-exact translation or other candidate. Translation proposals are retained only when one visible-training-exact offset is unambiguous. The added relations are: `distinct_color_scale`, which derives an integer cell-expansion factor from every distinct input color including the modal color; `quadrant_odd_one_out`, which returns the sole distinct quadrant only when a single central uniform cross creates four equal quadrants with exactly three identical; `singleton_foreground_border`, which projects exactly one strictly interior non-background seed onto the input-sized outer border after rederiving the unique modal background and seed color; and `distinct_color_count_line`, which learns a conflict-free mapping from visible input color-counts to full line motifs and one shared visible output foreground/background pair, refusing unseen counts, non-line outputs, conflicts, and ambiguous geometry. P0027's immutable 3/40 source-pinned baseline is the same-cohort pre-change denominator. P0027 is exposed development evidence, so this packet is development evidence only, not independent transfer evidence and not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim. The live controller receives only visible training input/output examples and test inputs. It receives no task ID, imported cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out output before committing a complete grid. P0027 baseline bytes and reports remain immutable; P0028 results cannot retune this frozen controller or its operator vocabulary.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: The frozen P0027 baseline exposed an allowed development failure taxonomy, and its published post-answer reports remain available as development evidence. Offline-only source-pinned feature audits motivated input-derived color-inventory, central-divider quadrant, singleton-seed, and line-motif relations. The controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code. The pre-beam repair uses only the controller's visible training compatibility assessments.
